sources.snippet: The model was trained to minimise cross-entropy, not to produce geodesic trajectories. That the learned force field happens to be nearly metric-compatible is an emergent structural property — the scalar and pairwise potentials organise the hidden-state manifold so that the minimum-energy paths are also the most predictive paths.
